info.name: NC 3D Print
info.summary: Slice, send, and monitor Klipper/Moonraker 3D prints from Nextcloud
info.description: NC 3D Print — standalone Nextcloud app that ships its own headless Orca slicing engine (the nc-print-slicer sidecar), Moonraker printer control, and live camera monitoring. No external slicer service and no NC-GCS dependency required.
info.author: NC-GCS Program
